args.name: Emergency opportunistic food foraging
args.function: Search for reachable food across resource types using actual observations and personally supported food-safety evidence; collect and immediately eat suitable food before continuing, rather than searching only for one named resource.
args.conditions: At tick 161 I have health 92, satiety 0, energy about 9.89, and no inventory. Starvation has caused damage. My last bounded berry search collected nothing. All currently visible food plants have zero stock. Berries are personally recorded as nutritious and nontoxic; other foods require supported safety evidence. No food availability is assumed.
args.inputs: A bounded search area, time and energy limits, an eating-energy reserve, health and temperature stops, and personal food evidence. Prefer reachable ripe sources; allow limited exploration only when feasible.
args.costs: Unknown implementation method. Actual travel, observation, gathering and eating must retain their real costs. Learning may take time. Do not create food, reveal hidden supplies, waive costs or restore health by declaration.
args.effects: Provide a feasible survival-oriented search and immediate-eating routine across supported edible resources, reporting unresolved food safety and stopping honestly when no reachable food is found. Starvation alone should not prevent a bounded attempt to obtain food; preserve enough energy to eat. No guaranteed discovery or healing.

execution.progress: start or resume continues with the same action, one step per round, until it completes or stops; a round taken by another action pauses it. Steps and costs stay.

details.costs: No cost of its own: each round runs one ordinary step at its own cost. navigate: actual distance x 2 energy, raised by ground and carried mass, at most 0.8 distance per round; probe observe: 1 round, 0.2 energy; gather: 1 round, 2 energy per unit. Each step is priced first against the path, time and energy left and the energy reserve; a step that does not fit is not taken and the search stops. time counts every round since start, paused ones too. Study: 1 round; needs navigate, probe and gather.
details.effects: start: resource, radius around x, y (default your position), path, time, energy, reserve, quantity. Candidates: sources of that resource you see now, or remember out of view, inside the radius, with ripe stock; nearest reach first; sources made by another person are left alone. It walks to one with navigate, inspects it with probe, then gathers min(stock, quantity left, units the energy allows). Sources seen empty are noted, not visited. If none is known it may walk to observed dry ground inside the radius to see its unseen parts; one known but beyond the limits stops it. It completes at the quantity or when nothing is left (perhaps with 0), and stops at a limit, health <= 60, satiety <= 8, body temperature 10 from 22 or an injury in the last round. Another action pauses it; resume rechecks all; cancel or death ends it. Nothing is refunded, created or eaten; no reward.

details.effects: start: the inputs of bounded-resource-search; without options it works exactly as that search (ripe sources seen now or remembered inside the radius, nearest reach first; walk, probe, gather; else walk to observed dry ground to see unseen parts). recheck: then sources last seen empty, seen now or in your own memory; a remembered one is only a navigate destination, its stock is learned by probe in reach; each is inspected at most once per run. emergency: satiety <= 8 alone does not stop it; health <= 60, an injury in the last round, body temperature 10 from 22 and every limit still do; minHealth, minTemp, maxTemp stop it sooner. avoidAreas (x, y, radius) and avoidDirections (from the origin): sources and ground there are left out and no step enters them. With recheck or emergency a food search needs reserve >= 1 (eat's energy). Another action pauses it; resume rechecks; cancel or death ends it. Nothing is refunded, created or eaten; no reward.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. An entry marked inRetrieval is shown with at least the same content under the same id in this input's retrieval. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

value.name: Bounded food foraging
value.function: Find ripe food of kinds your own eating records support in an area; gather one unit, then eat it; one navigate, probe, gather or eat step per round within limits.
value.costs: No cost of its own: one ordinary step per round at its own cost. navigate: distance x 2 energy (more on rough ground or loaded), <= 0.8 per round; probe observe: 0.2 energy; gather: 2 energy per unit; eat: eat's 1 energy (more when mood is low), real nutrition and toxicity. Each step is priced first against path, time, energy and reserve; a gather only if it and the next eat both fit. Paused rounds count. Study: 1 round; needs navigate, probe, gather, eat.
value.effects: start: radius around x, y (default you), path, time, energy, reserve >= 1 (never spent below), quantity (units to eat), evidenceRefs (up to 6 record ids). Only kinds your cited eating records support as edible and nontoxic are eaten (assess-food-suitability's evaluator); other kinds seen are reported safety unresolved. A carried eligible unit is eaten first. Ripe sources of eligible kinds seen now or remembered in the radius, nearest reach first across kinds; recheck: then sources last seen empty, probed once per run. Remembered places are only destinations; stock is probed in reach. Walk, probe, gather one unit, eat it next. explore: walk to observed dry ground to see unseen parts. Stops: health <= minHealth (default 60, 20 to 100), injury in the last round other than starvation alone, body temperature <= 12 or >= 32, minTemp, maxTemp, any limit. avoidAreas, avoidDirections as in recheck. Ends at the cap or full satiety. Another action pauses; resume rechecks; cancel or death ends. No refund or reward; food not assured.
